objective: Determine whether the observed 33-second browser result is a reproducible production-media VLM latency and improve operator-facing progress guidance without changing model semantics.

sample.production_media_path: StillImage EXIF transpose, RGB conversion and deterministic PNG encoding
sample.production_contract: formal label registry, compact production prompt, strict JSON schema, 256 image-token service, 384 completion budget

media_encoding_control.interpretation: Production PNG normalization changes the exact request and cache key, but did not cause semantic drift or a 30-second latency class on this sample.

diagnosis.decision: Reject a heavier production-shaped startup prewarm. Treat 33.018 seconds as one observed browser outlier, not a proven recurring compile cost. Preserve the current model protocol and collect phase-bound browser observations if it recurs.

accepted_changes.browser_acceptance_instrumentation: Record every prefetch response wall time and bounded phase receipt even when the test does not wait for dwell prefetch.
accepted_changes.operator_guidance: Separate the measured 15-25 second first-candidate expectation from later Agent and high-risk background review.

boundary: This round improves measurement fidelity and progress clarity. It does not reduce the approximately 15.5-second cold VLM generation itself and does not prove model accuracy or new-dataset generalization.
